title: Griffin Portrait
content: Until yesterday, I had never painted a living griffin before.A magnificent specimen named China Blue Rockett posed for me during my hour-long demo on water-soluble colored pencils at Anthrocon.I used an assortment of Caran d'Ache Supracolor 2 pencils. After a light lay-in, I scumbled a few colors and dissolved them with three Niji water brushes: one filled with clear water, another with a middle gray (the strokes on the sleeve), and another with black.By juggling the water brushes, I kept the edge around the head soft, so as to suggest the fringe of fur without painting every hair.------Anthrocon aka FurryconMore on GJ on that colored pencil techniqueWiki on Griffins(or if you prefer the spelling: griffon, gryphon, γρύφων, grýphōn,, γρύπων, or grýpōn).
